en: A sepia-toned photograph of a narrow cobblestone street lined with long colonial buildings. On the right, a projecting wooden balcony with a tiled roof juts out from the corner of a stone wall, characteristic of Spanish colonial architecture. Overhead, utility wires and a single hanging streetlight are visible against a misty sky. At the bottom, a caption in Spanish identifies the scene as a colonial corner and the 'camarín' (chapel or dressing room) of the old church of the Monastery of El Carmen in Bogotá, Colombia. A small printed number appears in the lower right corner.
